runtimeMapping.normal: single INPUT target; first actual Attack_Begin .333 plus Loop .033, later Loop .033; uncapped ASPD; tracking15/s,life5; four equal-weight original RandomCreateBuff outputs on impact
runtimeMapping.trait: source maxHP ratio .01 every1s after first wait; direct loss bypasses modifiers/SP, floor1; inherited generic drain disabled
runtimeMapping.talents: selected promotion cocktail parameters, E2/potential healing scale, no cocktail roll on ally stimpack fixed damage
runtimeMapping.stimpack: eligible other operator in source range; forward centre-line first, nearest then deployment order; locked input life; original .633 Skill OnAttack +14 births .03 apart divided ASPD; tracking20/s life5; each fixed500 physical receipt independently mitigated/dodged and defensive-SP eligible; last parallel fake projectile gives ally buff after last damage projectile; self buff at original1.267 Skill end; expiry anchored at skill activation; target-born buff survives source withdrawal
runtimeMapping.controls: control epoch cancels unborn actions including transient disarm; original already born projectiles unmanaged and source-invalid flag0; selected ally death does not retarget; fresh redeployment uses new life identity

verificationLimits: Original character, three skills, all matching projectile graphs, seven original buff templates,30 rank rows, promotion/potential talents and both actual native facing chains are retained. Raw serialized fields do not execute native C# controllers.

Selector postFilter21 comparator is not executable: forward centre-line, nearest distance and deployment order are the declared local comparator; eligibility currently admits operators only, not summons/devices.

Parallel/SequentialAbility completion order is not executable: self buff starts at selected native Skill clip end (1.267/ASPD). Recipient last-fake projectile is scheduled after the corresponding damage birth; same-tick native collision/priority, interruptions during parallel subabilities and absolute expiry origin are bounded local choices. No native frame-parity claim.
Source PURE skip-modifier undeadable decay is represented by direct HP loss after one second, without SP, capped to1HP. Native fractional rounding and scheduler phase are not recovered.

Talents roll equal weights on impact before local damage calculation. Native RandomCreateBuff/controller callback priority against dodge, projectile invalidation, same-frame source retirement and other modifiers is not measured.
S2 maxHP uses the existing simulator percentage-stat convention (currentHP ratio retained). Native currentHP adjustment at maxHP gain/loss needs client evidence.
No module support, original Unity particle/audio reconstruction or game-wide enemy/stage parity.
